titulo.alumno: Intermediate · Travel and accommodation: Guided writing

intro: T2 · Elementary · Understand the meaning and details of everyday written exchanges; understand notices, timetables and simple descriptive texts. Topic: Travel and accommodation. Focus: Lexical and grammar practice.

palabras.consejo: Practise the word within a sentence and pay attention to the tone.

texto: Guided writing for accommodation matters: write short messages confirming a booking or enquiring about lodging. Key structures: 1) «ฉันจองห้องพักไว้แล้วค่ะ» (I have a reservation). 2) «มีห้องว่างไหมครับ» (asking about vacancies). Check that the words «โรงแรม», «จอง» and «ห้องพัก» are spelled accurately.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «การสอบถามบริการรถรับส่งสนามบินช่วยประหยัดเวลาในการเดินทางวันกลับ» express?

opciones.texto: Requesting an airport transfer saves time on the return trip.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «การสอบถามบริการรถรับส่งสนามบินช่วยประหยัดเวลาในการเดินทางวันกลับ» from the text.

opciones.texto: Checking your valuables before leaving the room prevents accidental forgetfulness.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Booking a hotel online lets you get good rates and a good location.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.
